distribution: Weinan, Ceheng, Guizhou, 780 m above sea level.
soldier: Head, antennae and anterior part of the pronotum reddish yellow, nasus brownish yellow, the rest of the body pale yellow and nearly white. The tip of the nasus bears sparse short hairs, the head, thorax and abdominal tergites with sparse pilosity. Head somewhat an equilateral triangle, narrowest at the base of the nasus, constricted behind the antennal sockets and then markedly widening posteriorly, widest near the posterior end; posterior margin of the head shallowly concave in the middle, the posterior part swollen, the posterior margin forming an arc. Nasus short, about half the length of the head, not upturned in profile, slightly concave in the middle. Mandibles blunt, without a pointed projection at the tip. Antennae with 13 segments, the third longer than the second, the fourth shorter than the second. Pronotum very short, more than three times as wide as long, its anterior and posterior halves meeting almost at right angles.
taxonomy_note: The genus name recorded in the original work is spelt Ahmeditermes; it is now unified under the genus Ahmaditermes.
worker: In the worker the first marginal tooth of the left mandible is slightly shorter than the apical tooth, or nearly as long as the apical tooth; the second marginal tooth lies close to the molar plate, extremely small, projecting as a small triangle; the cutting edge between the first and second marginal teeth smooth; the anterior cutting edge of the molar plate straight. First marginal tooth of the right mandible pointed, the second short and blunt. The T-shaped marking on the pronotum and the ocellus-like spots at the anterolateral angles are both very distinct; the anterior margin of the pronotum nearly straight, the posterior margin widely and deeply concave; the posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum each with an inverted V-shaped depression.
